subject: Ironbridge escalations — risk closure cadence & RCA delivery
messages:
From: david.kim@redwood.ai
To: samir@ironbridge.com, priya.rao@ironbridge.com
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-15T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Ironbridge escalations — risk closure cadence & RCA delivery

Samir, Priya —

Thanks again for patience this week. We know the throughput-induced error surge and the sustained tail latency were disruptive to Ironbridge’s storefront traffic. I’m attaching a draft RCA (ironbridge_rca_draft_v1.pdf) and our initial action tracker that lays out concrete mitigations and owners.

High-level summary (TL;DR):
- Root cause: a new model shard scheduling behavior combined with a slow KV cache fallback path produced sustained queuing at the serving layer when peak token-per-second exceeded expected buckets. This drove token queue growth and a 5xx spike between 02:14–02:46 UTC on 2028-06-14.
- Immediate mitigations already applied: (1) manual throttling of non-critical background inference jobs, (2) patch to ensure cache fallback uses a fast-path circuit, (3) temporary reduction of per-request max tokens for long-running batch jobs.

Requested from Ironbridge: an executive-aligned closure cadence so your leadership has clear milestones and SLAs for risk acceptance. Internally I’ve proposed the following:
1) By EOD 2028-06-15: deliver signed action tracker with owners and dates.
2) By 2028-06-17: production canary of the scheduling fix in us-west with 48h observation window.
3) By 2028-06-21: complete automated load-test validation and handoff of runbook to Ironbridge SRE.

Attached is the RCA draft and a spreadsheet with owners. Please confirm if the cadence above aligns with Ironbridge expectations or propose alternate dates.

—David
David Kim
Enterprise Accounts, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: ironbridge_rca_draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB), ironbridge_action_tracker.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)

From: samir@ironbridge.com
To: david.kim@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.rao@ironbridge.com, contracts@ironbridge.com
Date: 2028-06-15T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ironbridge escalations — risk closure cadence & RCA delivery

David —

Thanks for the quick RCA draft and the mitigation notes. High level it looks reasonable. Two asks from our side before we commit to the dates above:
1) We need a clearer rollback plan for the scheduling fix in case the canary shows regression (latency or error increase).
2) Please include a compensation/credit proposal for the 3-hour outage window impact on our Prime customers — we’ll route contracting questions to contracts@ironbridge.com but want to make sure that is tracked.

Also looping in our ops lead (Priya) to coordinate the canary window. Can you confirm the schedule for the canary and what telemetry we’ll share?

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform, Ironbridge
samir@ironbridge.com

Date: 2028-06-15T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ironbridge escalations — risk closure cadence & RCA delivery

Samir — quick responses to your asks:

1) Rollback plan: we will run the canary as a traffic-split to a separate serving pool with identical configs except for the updated scheduler. If we observe error rate > baseline + 0.5% absolute or p99 latency worsening > 150ms for 15m sustained, automatic traffic shift will move 100% of Ironbridge traffic off the canary pool and an on-call eng will trigger the safe rollback. That rollback procedure is documented in the attached action tracker.

2) Credits: I’ve started a parallel thread with Finance to draft a compensation proposal. We’ll aim to include a draft credit figure in tomorrow’s update.

Telemetry: we will share the following dashboards during canary and validation:
- Request rate / errors by endpoint (1m granularity)
- P50/P90/P99 latency per model variant (1m)
- Queue depth and token-per-second metrics (10s)
- Sampling of error traces for 5xx responses (s3 links)

Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: action tracker (ironbridge_action_tracker.xlsx)

From: priya.rao@ironbridge.com
To: david.kim@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: samir@ironbridge.com, contracts@ironbridge.com
Date: 2028-06-16T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ironbridge escalations — risk closure cadence & RCA delivery

David/Naomi —

Thanks for the clarifications. Our Ops team is good with the rollback thresholds but requests that Ironbridge be the final arbiter for pushing full production traffic (we’ll want a manual thumbs-up after 24h of stable canary metrics).

On credits: Contracts asked for a short summary they can include with the invoice remediation. I’m attaching their requested format requirements (we’ll email contracts separately). Also, can you confirm the owner for the long-term change (kernel/scheduler) — we want a named engineering lead for post-deploy validation and future escalation points.

—Priya
Priya Rao
Ops Lead, Ironbridge
priya.rao@ironbridge.com

Subject: Re: Ironbridge escalations — risk closure cadence & RCA delivery

Priya/Samir —

I’ll own the long-term scheduler change and be the engineering lead for the canary. Short summary of what we’ll do on the engineering side:

- Implementation: the scheduler patch reduces shard grab window from 250ms -> 80ms under heavy load and enables early drain of KV-cache misses onto a hot-path threadpool.
- Canary plan: start at 1% Ironbridge traffic for 2 hours, then 5% for 4 hours, then 20% for 12 hours. At each step we verify the telemetry Naomi listed; threshold checks are automated.
- Post-canary validation: synthetic load test (10k requests/s for 30m) to validate no regression for other tenants; then gradual ramp to 100% per Ironbridge manual approval.

We’ll also deliver a signoff-ready runbook and a short run-through meeting for Ironbridge ops before the canary.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: service-metrics-20280614.csv

From: david.kim@redwood.ai
To: samir@ironbridge.com, priya.rao@ironbridge.com

Date: 2028-06-17T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ironbridge escalations — risk closure cadence & RCA delivery

Samir/Priya —

Thanks for the alignment. Per your ask, we’ve: 
- Attached the updated RCA (final v1) and the signed action tracker inside Drive (link above).
- Karthik will lead the rollout and is the named engineering owner for post-deploy validation.
- Naomi will coordinate credit/compensation and share a formal proposal by 2028-06-18.

Next steps:
- 2028-06-18 10:00 PDT: canary readiness call (15m) — we’ll review the rollback criteria and telemetry dashboards.
- 2028-06-19 02:00 PDT: begin canary (per traffic split plan).
- 2028-06-21 EOD: handoff runbook to Ironbridge ops and close the escalation (pending signoffs).

If anything changes before the readiness call, I’ll update the thread immediately. Appreciate the tight collaboration to get this to a safe, observed closure.

—David
David Kim
Enterprise Accounts, Redwood Inference
